fact: A proof-of-concept Government Service Bus called Nawa, built in about a month at a national hackathon, linked four institutions (Tax Authority, Commercial Registry, Central Bank of Libya, Customs Authority) through 23 web service endpoints, and won the competition's grand prize in January 2025, per the paper's authors.

On 8 July 2026 the General Information Authority said its national projects, the Libyan National Data Exchange (LY-NDEX) among them, are a pillar enabling information exchange between government bodies; the story gives no go-live date, connected bodies or figures.

The General Information Authority, reporting a 20 April 2026 meeting with the Union of Chambers, describes the National Data Distributor as a sovereign operational platform for interoperability enabling secure exchange of data between entities, and says the Chambers Union's new electronic system is to interoperate with it; it names no connected bodies and gives no counts.

The chairman of the General Authority for Communications and Informatics said on 1 June 2026 that the National Data Distributor is linked to the banking sector, government agencies and service sectors.
The same chairman said the National Data Distributor recorded over 300 million data transactions last year.
